name: @aipm/debug-log-server
description: Install and use a dev-only local debug log server with AI-assisted setup.
usage: Run aipm add @aipm/debug-log-server, then run aipm show-prompt @aipm/debug-log-server and paste the saved setup prompt into your AI coding tool.
agentDescription: Use this skill when a project needs a local debug log collector, browser/client logging helper, Node logging helper, and poll/analyze loop for AI-assisted debugging. The package installs helper templates and a manual setup prompt; it does not execute setup automatically.

examples.title: Set up debug logging for AI's self debugging
examples.description: Install the helper files and ask an AI coding tool to add the logger to the current repo.
examples.prompt: Use the @aipm/debug-log-server setup prompt to install a local debug log server in this project.

examples.title: Trace a slow workflow
examples.description: Use debug logs to instrument a flow, reproduce it, and analyze the collected session.
examples.prompt: Use the debug log server workflow to instrument this slow startup path and identify the slowest step.

releaseNotes: Initial hybrid skill package with manual setup prompt and helper templates.
